'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Justin Desai LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: hard scrawl; line 1 reads "Ploht" (Profit?); illegible lines shown as (illegible); "A/R" lines left unexpanded

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]]
